instruction: A trapezoidal box zither hand-carved from a single walnut blank, its soundhole cut as an interlaced knotwork rosette. Chisel facets remain visible along the rounded body edges, the grain sweeping lengthwise beneath a warm oil finish, and a row of bone tuning pins lines the narrow end. Fine carved vine relief runs the long rail, catching light in shallow ridges.
